dcat_keyword_sm: Approved ROP 2022 - Map 8 - Mineral Aggregate Resource Areas
dct_description_sm:
Includes data required to create York Region Official Plan – 2022 Map 8: Agricultural and Rural Areas.  Data such as Holland Marsh Specialty Crop Areas, Rural areas and Agricultural Areas were used to create this map.


The data layers do not take the place of a legal survey or other primary source documentation and may not be used to determine, certify, or verify if a parcel is a qualifying or exempt property.
